acceptanceCriteria: The fresh-queue section states that the queueId authority segment must equal the repositoryAuthorityId suffix, with a matching example.
A doc check or test pins the stated constraint to the init validator.
body: docs/TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md tells adopters to customize queueId (`queue:example:main`) and repositoryAuthorityId (`repo:example`) separately. Setting queue:core:main with repo:beamfall-core makes `corvint-tasks init` (build 668) refuse MALFORMED `/queueId: queue authority "core" differs from repositoryAuthorityId "beamfall-core"`. Observed 2026-10-19 initializing beamfall core-history's store.
title: Fresh-queue guide does not say queueId authority must equal repositoryAuthorityId
